cases.name: Doreen Jennifer Lizdas Jacius
cases.about:
According to the East Granby Library, Doreen was the library’s director. They released a statement on Facebook saying, “The East Granby Public Library staff and Board of Directors are shocked and devastated by the sudden loss of our Director, Doreen Jacius. She was beloved by us and the community. Our entire community is mourning there are really no words to see how I feel about this, it’s a totally shocking death Doreen loved East Granby she lived here all her life she loved her job at the library she love the people she worked with she was just a pleasure to be with.“

Her oobituary said, "Doreen graduated from East Granby High School and received a Bachelor’s of Science degree in Business Administration from the University of Connecticut. Doreen’s friendly smile, generosity and devotion to her community touched the lives of so many people. She had an ambition to help others and did so with her graceful style of encouragement and positivity, raising others up to better versions of themselves. Words barely convey the magnitude of her impact on those she loved and served.

Doreen was a devoted mother. She was most proud of her two precious daughters, Sarah and Amanda. Even in midst of life’s expected and unexpected hurdles, Doreen met every challenge with a smile, courage and her quiet strength. Her daughters were the focus of her life, creating experiences and making lasting memories with them. Whether it was on beaches, on Broadway or in the mountains, Doreen lived life to the fullest with her family.

Doreen worked at the East Granby Public Library for over 6 years, serving as the Library Director for the past 4 years. She served the town of East Granby with pride and dedication. She was passionate about making the East Granby Library a place where everyone was welcome, creating with her staff and Board, a safe and warm place for all to come with no expectation of anything in return. Everyone she interacted with was treated with kindness and respect.

Doreen was loved by so many and she took every opportunity to show those around her how much she cared for and loved them deeply in creative ways. Taken from us too soon, her loss leaves a tremendous void in the lives of her family, friends and community. Though she may be gone from us physically, because she shared her love and light so generously and freely, her light will always shine bright in our hearts and minds. She has left footprints on our hearts and we will never, ever be the same."
